title: a color block mod
description: this add a block what changes colours
body:
A Colour Block Mod is a simple but fun Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds the Colour Block — a special block that randomly changes colour every time you right-click it!
Features:

1. Right-click to randomly cycle through 16 colours
2. Each colour emits a different light level — white glows brightest, black doesn't glow at all
3. Semi shader support for Iris & OptiFine
4. Redstone 4. compatible — send a pulse to randomly change the colour automatically
5. Mine with a pickaxe to recover the block, or break it without one to get 9 Colour Shards
6. Craft 9 Colour Shards back into a Colour Block
7. Custom crafting recipe — surround white concrete with 8 dyes
8. Comes with its own creative tab

Requirements:

Fabric Loader
Fabric API
